description: This is a false-colour satellite image, acquired by Spot 5 (2.5 m resolution) on 2011-08-12, depicting a landscape dominated by agricultural land and urban areas near a river system in Úbeda, Spain. The image uses a 1/2/3 band combination, typically rendering healthy vegetation in red tones. The upper left and central-left areas show urban development with grey and some reddish-brown structures, along with linear features indicative of roads and infrastructure. Large expanses of light brown, reddish-brown, and patterned fields, consistent with agricultural use and possibly vineyards (as suggested by the surrounding document context), cover the central and left portions of the image. A prominent river system flows from the upper right towards the lower centre, bordered by bright red strips representing dense, healthy riparian vegetation. Irregular, textured terrain, likely natural vegetation or scrubland, is visible in the upper right. Turquoise lines are overlaid, delineating the river banks, some field boundaries, and potentially highlighting specific land cover features or areas of interest for mapping and analysis. The image source is CNES 2011©, distributed by Airbus DS/Spot Image.
